description: Unit tests for the HttpRequestHeaders class, testing header manipulation functions such as setting, removing, merging, and parsing headers.

methods.name: HasHeader
methods.description: Test for presence of headers with case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Test for setting headers and verifying string output.

methods.name: SetMultipleHeaders
methods.description: Test for setting multiple headers and verifying combined output.

methods.name: SetHeaderTwice
methods.description: Test for setting the same header twice.

methods.name: SetHeaderTwiceCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Test for case-insensitive header setting.

methods.name: SetHeaderTwiceSamePrefix
methods.description: Test for headers with similar prefixes.

methods.name: SetEmptyHeader
methods.description: Test for setting headers with empty values.

methods.name: SetHeaderIfMissing
methods.description: Test for conditional header setting.

methods.name: RemoveHeader
methods.description: Test for removing headers.

methods.name: RemoveHeaderMissingHeader
methods.description: Test for removing non-existent headers.

methods.name: RemoveHeaderCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Test for case-insensitive header removal.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromString
methods.description: Test for parsing headers from string.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringNoLeadingWhitespace
methods.description: Test parsing header without leading whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringMoreLeadingWhitespace
methods.description: Test parsing header with extra whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringTrailingWhitespace
methods.description: Test parsing header with trailing whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringLeadingTrailingWhitespace
methods.description: Test parsing header with leading and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringWithEmptyValue
methods.description: Test parsing header with empty value.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringWithWhitespaceValue
methods.description: Test parsing header with whitespace value.

methods.name: MergeFrom
methods.description: Test merging headers from another header set.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Test copying headers from another header set.
